A '''Thorsen field driver''' was a component of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] Thorsen field driver began to hiccup when reaching [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]]. The crew theorized that, should it happen once more, they could suffer physical damage. They then decided to look for a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] with repair facilities to have the driver overhauled. One of the crew was an old friend of [[Scarlet Bloodhawk]], and the crew decided to visit her [[Scarlet Bloodhawk's spaceport|port]].<ref name="Reunion" />
